desc: Derive the precise BFS-layer characterization and prove that it counts every connected labeled graph exactly once.
Formulate the edge-count generating polynomial for a fixed sequence of layer sizes, including intra-layer edges and adjacent-layer edge constraints.
Derive an efficient inclusion-exclusion formula for bipartite edges where every vertex in the next layer has at least one previous-layer neighbor.
Develop the direct BFS-layer DP in full detail, including exact state transitions, label-count factors, edge-polynomial updates, and a complexity bound suitable for implementing at N=30.
Analyze polynomial-convolution/precomputation optimizations and implementation details under arbitrary prime modulus near \(10^9\).
Validate the derived recurrence against tree and complete-graph boundary cases and sample outputs.
